# Hilton Family Law

> Family law firm in Antioch, California, serving Contra Costa County and the East Bay. Practice areas include divorce, child custody, child and spousal support, property division, domestic violence, enforcement, modifications, retirement, and set-asides.

Site content is general information, not legal advice. For guidance about a specific situation, contact the firm directly.

Office: 5181 Lone Tree Way, Antioch, CA 94531. Phone (925) 384-2086. Fax (925) 775-7065. Email legal@amyhiltonlaw.com. Canonical pages use trailing slashes; legacy URLs redirect with HTTP 301.

## Site

- [Home](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/): Overview of the firm and primary services
- [Contact](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/contact/): Office details and consultation request form

## Practice areas

- [Child custody](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/child-custody/): Custody and visitation
- [Child and spousal support](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/child-and-spousal-support/): Guideline support, paternity, and related orders
- [Property division](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/property-division/): Division of community and separate property
- [Domestic violence](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/domestic-violence/): Protective orders and related family law matters
- [Retirement](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/retirement/): Military and civilian retirement in divorce
- [Modifications](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/modifications/): Changes to custody and support orders
- [Enforcement](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/enforcement/): Enforcement of court orders and agreements
- [Set asides](https://amyhiltonlaw.com/services/set-asides/): Set-aside of judgments and agreements
